original_text: Make it a 3x3x3 cube with no gravity: players still alternate placing X and O in any empty cell; any straight line of three cells through the cube (rows, columns, pillars and every diagonal, 49 lines in total) wins; a full cube with no line is a draw.
preserve: Players alternate placing X and O.
A player may place a mark only in an empty cell.
changes: Allow placement in any empty cell without gravity.
A straight line of three cells through the cube wins, including rows, columns, pillars, and every diagonal; there are 49 winning lines in total.
A full cube with no winning line is a draw.
